City of Encinitas
Senior Citizen Commission Regular Meeting
AGENDA
TUESDAY, APRIL 19, 2022 -
2:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES Approve the March 15, 2022 meeting minutes.
7. March 15, 2022 Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
SENIOR CITIZEN COMMISSION ANNUAL WORK PLAN
Recommend Action: 1) Finalize the FY 2022/23 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan. 2) Finalize the ad-hoc committees to accomplish FY 2022/23 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan goals.
8A. Senior Citizen Commission Annual Work Plan
8B.
CITY OF ENCINITAS WEBSITE FEEDBACK
Provide staff with suggestions on improving the city website in relation to senior citizen content.
8B. City of Encinitas Website Feedback
8C.
SENIOR OF THE YEAR/LIFETIME ACHIEVEMENT AWARD PROGRAM
Recommend Action: Senior Citizen Commission extend the nomination deadline to allow for additional participation.
8C. Senior of the Year/Lifetime Achievement Award Program
8D.
RECOMMENDATION OF A SHADE STRUCTURE AT THE ENCINITAS COMMUNITY AND SENIOR CENTER
Recommend Action: Approve the recommendation to purchase the Great Western Recreation shade structure over the outdoor fitness equipment at the Encinitas Community and Senior Center.
8D. Recommendation of a Shade Structure
9.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS Recreation Center Manager Goodsell, Senior Center Operations Report and Recreation Services Manager Tracy Stayton, Department Updates
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
None
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Items added with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSION REPORTS Roundtable – All Commissioners
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
